mapper.select: select user_id, company_name, account_name, client_path, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from sop_amazon_image_upload_user_config where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sop_amazon_image_upload_user_config( user_id, company_name, account_name, client_path, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{companyName}, #{accountName}, #{clientPath}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sop_amazon_image_upload_user_config set company_name = #{companyName}, account_name = #{accountName}, client_path = #{clientPath}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
